question: In the psychology of motivation, balance theory is a theory of attitude change, proposed by ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Fritz Heider**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Fritz Heider proposed that the **balance theory is a theory of attitude change.**
 
• It conceptualizes the **cognitive consistency** motive as a drive toward psychological balance.
 
• This theory was developed in **1946**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **John A List** is an American economist.
 
• **Milton Friedman** is also an American economist and statistician.
 
• **Adam Smith** is a Scottish economist and philosopher.
